column1: # Hand-labelled cases for the matcher evaluation (native/host/eval.cpp and the
# Kotlin twin's JVM test both score against this file).
# One row = one assertion: for this query, must the matcher report this CVE?
#   platform: a = release (as mapped from SDK_INT), b = security patch level
#   kernel:   a = uname -r,                          b = patch level used for the kernel
#   app:      a = package name,                      b = versionName
# Labels were written from the source advisory (OSV Android / NVD) by reading the
# rule, not by running the matcher. The note says why.
# Kernel truth = patch level behind the bulletin fix AND upstream version inside
# an NVD range (or no range known). See README "kernel: version vs patch level".
